observations: Exercise bike with a digital console at the front.
Orange and white pedals and footrests.
White tubular frame with adjustable height mechanism.
The brand name 'ELEVEN' is visible on the side of the frame in photo 0.
The bike is positioned on artificial green turf against a plain wall.

claims.evidence: The photo shows a clean, unused bike, but 'fair used' is a subjective term for used goods.

risks.risk: The digital console may not power on or display data.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powered on and displaying heart rate or distance.

risks.risk: The pedals or resistance mechanism may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the bike being pedaled to demonstrate resistance and smooth movement.

risks.risk: The frame may have hidden structural damage or rust.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame joints and welds.

proof_requests: Video of the bike powered on and showing the console screen.
Video of the pedals being used to demonstrate resistance.
Close-up photos of the frame joints and welds.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the photo. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional) until proof of operation is provided.
